records.title_zh: 先按指令移动，再画路线
records.title_en: Move first, then draw the route
records.purpose: Connect positional language to actual movement and representation.
records.setup: Floor grid or board grid with a start point.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 从起点向前3格、右转四分之一圈、再前进2格。最后在哪里？把路线画下来。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Move forward 3 squares, make a quarter turn right, then move forward 2 squares. Where do you finish? Draw the route.
records.expected_thinking: Language for direction and turn maps consistently to movement and a spatial representation.
records.listen_for: Confusing right turn with moving right; losing orientation after a turn.
records.variation: Give the drawn route and ask pupils to write the instructions.

records.teacher_prompt_zh: (2,5)和(5,2)为什么不是同一个点？第一个数和第二个数分别表示什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Why are (2,5) and (5,2) different points? What does the first coordinate show and what does the second show?
records.expected_thinking: Coordinates are ordered: x gives horizontal position and y gives vertical position.
records.listen_for: Swapping coordinates without noticing; treating the pair as an unordered set.
records.variation: Extend to negative coordinates where curriculum placement supports it.

records.purpose: Define line symmetry through reflection rather than visual balance.
records.setup: Shape with one true and one plausible false symmetry line.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 不要只看起来像。选一个点，检查它关于这条线的对应点在哪里、距离是否相等。哪条才是真正的对称轴？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Do not decide only by appearance. Choose a point and locate its reflected point. Are the distances from the line equal? Which line is a true line of symmetry?
records.expected_thinking: Reflection maps corresponding points to equal perpendicular distances on opposite sides of the symmetry line.
records.listen_for: Accepting approximate visual balance without point correspondence.
records.variation: Complete half a figure across a diagonal symmetry line.

records.title_zh: 所有点移动同一个位移
records.title_en: Every point moves by the same displacement
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 把三角形向右4格、向上2格平移。每个顶点分别发生了什么？图形的大小和方向变了吗？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Translate the triangle 4 squares right and 2 up. What happens to every vertex? Did the size or orientation change?
records.expected_thinking: Each point has the same displacement; size and orientation are preserved.
records.listen_for: Turning or flipping the shape while moving it.
records.variation: Give original and image and ask pupils to describe the translation.
records.evidence_note: Common Core Grades 1-6 has no systematic translation-transformation strand; apply framework nonmatch rule in US comparison mode.

records.purpose: Specify centre, direction and angle of rotation.
records.setup: Shape and marked centre of rotation.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 只说‘转一下’不够。怎样完整描述这次旋转？中心在哪里？方向是什么？转了多少度？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Saying 'turn it' is not enough. How can you fully describe this rotation? Where is the centre, what is the direction, and what is the angle?
records.expected_thinking: An exact rotation is determined by a centre, direction and angle/amount of turn.
records.listen_for: Describing only clockwise/counterclockwise with no angle or centre.
records.variation: Give the description and ask pupils to construct the image.
records.evidence_note: Common Core Grades 1-6 has no systematic rotation-transformation strand; apply framework nonmatch rule in US comparison mode.
